Writes the argument to the current exit-data byte.

facts.rationale: Preserves the observed data flow while correcting the interpretation of the cross-file output.
facts.value: Reads and decrements the persistent input-delay and exit timers in priority order. With both zero, newly triggered A or Start from gm_GetButtonsTriggered(gm_801BF010()) calls lbBgFlash_8002063C(60), writes 60 to the exit timer, then calls lbAudioAx_80023694 and sfxForward. Exit-timer expiration passes 6 for GM_DEBUG_GOVER or 1 otherwise to gm_801A6630, which writes that value into current scene exit data and calls gm_801A4B60; the values are exit codes, not locally proven scene indices.

evidence.why: Exit-code storage rather than direct scene indexing.

facts.rationale: Replaces unsupported scene-number and broad audio-stop interpretations with exact state transitions and calls.
facts.value: Entry sets the input-delay timer to 30 and the exit timer to zero. Each frame exclusively drains input delay, drains an active exit countdown, or accepts a newly triggered A/Start press. Accepted input calls lbBgFlash_8002063C(60), starts a 60-frame exit countdown, and calls lbAudioAx_80023694 followed by sfxForward. Countdown expiry passes exit-data code 6 for debug game-over or 1 otherwise to gm_801A6630. This helper stores the code and calls gm_801A4B60; no literal destination-scene mapping or audio/movie completion test is established by these callbacks.
